changes.title: Measured Android Back correlation without navigation changes
changes.text: Private developer builds correlate Android system/GDX Back routing, duplicate-gate decisions, queue, render dispatch, window handler and hide timing with monotonic route IDs. Normal player builds remain disabled. The complete 2059-method core gate passed; this is instrumentation for physical phone evidence, not a claimed lag fix or a debounce change.

changes.title: Exact healing after recorded hero damage
changes.text: Choose an exact recorded hit against the hero and inspect HP healing strictly after that turn through 1, 5, 10, 20 or 50 turns inclusive. Same-turn healing is excluded because its ordering is unknown. Results retain exact run identity, scope, disclosure, evidence and exports; missing coverage is unknown and observed totals are lower bounds without a causation claim.

changes.title: Complete core evidence and current fallback retained
changes.text: Corrected source passed 2064 methods in 400 suites with zero failures, errors or skips, including all five damage-recovery, six shared turn-window and three BackTrace cases. The initial fixture-only compile failure remains recorded. TEST310 acceptance remains the fallback until the new native and artifact gates pass.
